v3_preview.title: Temporary TV proof (QA only, NO login)
v3_preview.description: Start the 2-minute v3 test on the TV DEBUG app first. Then choose Start here. This exchanges public ephemeral keys and produces an eight-digit code. No HA login or bearer token is shared.

data.start_test: Start the secure code comparison test

v3_code.title: Compare all eight digits on TV and Home Assistant
v3_code.description: Home Assistant code: {code}. Compare all EIGHT digits with the TV screen, then press the TV's physical remote OK button. This proves TV identity only and does not log it into Home Assistant.

data.numbers_match: All eight digits matched and I pressed OK on the actual TV remote

abort.discovery_only: This QA integration only works when a TV debug app advertises the temporary v3 mDNS session.
abort.invalid_discovery: Invalid v3 TV discovery. Restart the temporary pairing test on your TV.
abort.cancelled: Cancelled: your current HA and TV login were not changed.
abort.expired: The temporary test expired. Start again using the TV physical remote.
abort.mismatch: Codes did not match. No pairing or login was changed.
abort.verified_no_login: SUCCESS: The physical TV and secure v3 session were verified. This is NOT a Home Assistant login. Your normal Kellie's Voice setup was not changed.

error.unavailable: Could not contact the temporary v3 TV test. Start again on the TV.
error.waiting_for_tv: Waiting for the physical TV remote approval. Verify all digits and press OK on the TV.
